title: Difficult to differentiate between dates when using alternate calendar
line: With an alternate calendar on, its day numbers in the calendar are now drawn in the accent color, so they are easy to tell apart from the regular dates.
explanation: The calendar's DayDelegate draws the alternate calendar's day number (or sub-day label) under each date as a smaller label in the same text color, so the two sets of numbers blur together across the grid. The change gives that label the highlight color, and keeps the normal text color on today and the selected day, where the highlighted cell background would make highlight-colored text hard to read.

commits.message:
components/calendar: Color the alternate calendar's day numbers

Alternate calendar day numbers had the same color as the main ones and
only a smaller size, so they were hard to tell apart. Draw them in the
highlight color, except on the highlighted today and selected days.

BUG: 473158

patches.diff:
From 406eff62cab5fcf765e1d6e50a4e41da5573ec7b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 21:50:43 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] components/calendar: Color the alternate calendar's day
 numbers

Alternate calendar day numbers had the same color as the main ones and
only a smaller size, so they were hard to tell apart. Draw them in the
highlight color, except on the highlighted today and selected days.

BUG: 473158
---
 components/calendar/qml/DayDelegate.qml | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/components/calendar/qml/DayDelegate.qml b/components/calendar/qml/DayDelegate.qml
index 2070c055ed..bdda84a38e 100644
--- a/components/calendar/qml/DayDelegate.qml
+++ b/components/calendar/qml/DayDelegate.qml
@@ -263,6 +263,7 @@ PlasmaComponents.AbstractButton {
                 horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                 verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                 maximumLineCount: 1
+                color: dayStyle.today || dayStyle.selected ? Kirigami.Theme.textColor : Kirigami.Theme.highlightColor
                 opacity: label.opacity
                 // Prefer sublabel over day number
                 text: dayStyle.model.subDayLabel || dayStyle.model.alternateDayNumber?.toString() || ''
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Islamic (civil) alternate calendar on master: the second numbers are the same color as the dates
Same calendar with the fix: the alternate day numbers are in the accent color; today keeps normal text
Breeze Dark: the selected day (6th) keeps normal text, the rest use the accent color
Chinese calendar: its sub-day labels (lunar days, solar terms) get the same color

review.text: Coloring the alternate calendar sub-day label in DayDelegate.qml with Kirigami.Theme.highlightColor while falling back to Kirigami.Theme.textColor on today and selected cells cleanly solves the differentiation problem without hurting legibility on highlighted cells. Surrounding bindings, opacity for non-current-month dates, tooltips, and accessibility descriptions remain intact, and there are no QML hazards or binding loops. The before/after screenshots verify Breeze Light, Breeze Dark, selected/today states, and Chinese calendar sub-day labels convincingly.

reviews.text: Coloring the alternate calendar sub-day label in DayDelegate.qml with Kirigami.Theme.highlightColor while falling back to Kirigami.Theme.textColor on today and selected cells cleanly solves the differentiation problem without hurting legibility on highlighted cells. Surrounding bindings, opacity for non-current-month dates, tooltips, and accessibility descriptions remain intact, and there are no QML hazards or binding loops. The before/after screenshots verify Breeze Light, Breeze Dark, selected/today states, and Chinese calendar sub-day labels convincingly.

This is the reporter's own mockup (attachment 160837), which Nate approved: alternate-calendar numbers in the accent colour, so they can be told apart from the main dates at a glance. The one-line binding in DayDelegate's sub-label is the right place, keeps the 0.5 opacity outside the current month, falls back to textColor on the today and selected highlights, and also covers the Chinese sub-day labels; the screenshots show it working in light and dark. The mockup's other complaint, too little vertical space between rows, no longer applies on master's taller cells. Nits: the mockup also coloured the alternate date line in the header, which would explain what the blue numbers mean, and small highlight-coloured text has low contrast with pale custom accents (e.g. yellow on Breeze light).
